m: माहि˚षिक m. prec. sg. VP.
the paramour of an unchaste woman (others ‘one who lives by the prostitution of his wife’), L.
माहि˚षिक f(आ or ई) N. of a river, R.,
a: माहिषिकः — 1 A buffalo-keeper, a herdsman. --2 The paramour of an unchaste woman; माहिषीत्युच्यते नारी या च स्याद् व्यभिचारिणी . तां दृष्टां कामयति यः स वै माहिषिकः स्मृतः .. Kālikā Purāṇa. --3 One who lives by the prostitution of his wife; महिषीत्युच्यते नार्या भगेनोपाजिंतं धनं . उपजीवति यस्तस्याः स वै माहिषिकः स्मृतः .. Śrīdhara on V. P.

m: माहिष्म m. pl. (cf. next) N. of a people, VP.

a: माहिष्मती — N. of a city, the hereditary capital of the Haihaya kings; R. 6. 43.
माहिष्मती — See under चेदि.

m: माहि˚ष्य m. a partic. mixed caste (the son of a Kṣatriya and a Vaiśyā mother whose business is attendance on cattle), Yājñ.; Gaut.
a: माहिष्यः — A mixed caste sprung from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother.
